storage: Keep in a cool, dark place in a closed container; no refrigeration needed. Use within a few months of opening for best flavour.
looksLike: A clear golden-yellow to amber oil with a sharp, pungent smell, darker and stronger than refined sunflower or groundnut oil.
howToPick: Look for "kachi ghani" and "pure" on the label with an FSSAI licence number; a sharp, pungent smell and clear golden colour are normal. Blended mustard oil can no longer be sold in India since 8 June 2021 (FSSAI, https://mail.fssai.gov.in/upload/media/FSSAI_new_mustard_Express_28_06_2021.pdf), so a "blended" label is a red flag.
shelfLife: Usually about a year from packing on the label; check the best-before date (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
